name: @aemonge-dev/pi-openspec-gate
description: pi-openspec-gate — openspec, extended. The micro loop: one plan.md per change, one human approve before code, every mutation receipted to the change's .ledger — via the eospec CLI (new, focus, approve, close) and a Pi extension that accounts every mutating tool call: allowed by path, attributed to the aimed change, declared by the human, or refused with instructions.
